user.title: Connect to HelloWatt
user.description: Please enter your HelloWatt API credentials.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate HelloWatt
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for {username} are invalid or have expired. Please enter your new password to continue.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to HelloWatt API

data_description.update_interval: How often to fetch new data from HelloWatt API (1-24 hours)
data_description.lookback_days: How many days of historical data to fetch (3-30 days)

import_historical_data.name: Import historical data
import_historical_data.description: Import historical consumption data from HelloWatt into Home Assistant statistics. Data is imported month by month to avoid API overload.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Start date for historical data import (YYYY-MM-DD). Data will be imported from the first day of this month.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: End date for historical data import (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today. Data will be imported up to the last day of this month.

pdl.name: PDL
pdl.description: PDL number to import data for. Leave empty to import for all configured PDLs.

clear_statistics.name: Clear statistics
clear_statistics.description: Clear all HelloWatt statistics from Home Assistant database. Use this before re-importing data to avoid conflicts with old metadata.

pdl.name: PDL
pdl.description: PDL number to clear statistics for. Leave empty to clear for all configured PDLs.
